meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用关键词、作者或主题搜索多个平台的学术论文，如 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE Xplore 等，并返回结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“搜索论文”、“找研究论文”、“上 arXiv 搜一下”等类似请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于机器学习的论文。
say.note: Claude 会在多个平台搜索相关论文。

say.text: 在 PubMed 上查 COVID-19 的文献。
搜索‘强化学习’相关的 arXiv 论文。
say.note: Claude 限定在 arXiv 搜索。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can search academic papers across multiple platforms like arXiv, PubMed, IEEE Xplore, etc., using keywords, authors, or topics, and return results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", etc.

say_en.text: Search for papers about machine learning.
say_en.note: Claude will search across multiple platforms.

say_en.text: Look up COVID-19 literature on PubMed.
Search arXiv for reinforcement learning papers.
